agencies.label: Bus
agencies.source: the NYC bus feeds give each route a map colour (EE352E, 6CBE45, FAA61A, 006CB7, B933AD, 00AEEF, 00933C) with no brand majority; MTA blue from the logo, approximate

agencies.label: Subway
agencies.source: subway.zip routes.txt: EB6800 (B D F FX M) on 5 of 29 routes, the most common informative colour; the other lines keep their route_color (A C E 0062CF, N Q R W F6BC26, 1 2 3 D82233, 4 5 6 009952, 7 9A38A1, G 799534, J Z 8E5C33, SIR 08179C)

rules.label: L and shuttles
rules.source: L and the three S shuttles are grey 7C858C in subway.zip, which is not informative; this slate stands in, approximate

agencies.label: LIRR
agencies.source: lirr.zip gives each of its 12 branches its own colour, so none is the agency's; A626AA is the Ronkonkoma Branch (and Greenport, outside the area), approximate

agencies.label: MNR
agencies.source: mnr.zip route_color EE0034 on 4 of 6 lines (New Haven and its branches)

agencies.label: CTA
agencies.source: cta.zip: buses are grey 99999C or 414145 on 105 of 124 routes (not informative) and B71234 on 18 express routes; CTA blue 0065BD is the J14 colour, approximate; L lines keep their own colours

agencies.label: Metra
agencies.source: metra.zip: each of the 11 lines has its own colour, none shared; Metra blue taken from the SWS line, approximate

agencies.label: METRO
agencies.source: houmetro.zip route_color 004080 on 105 of 106 bus routes; METRORail Red EF0000, Green 3E7E00, Purple 40007E keep their colours

agencies.label: Valley Metro
agencies.source: valleymetro.zip route_color 591769 on all 108 bus routes; Rail A 1E8ECD, B B76912 and the streetcar 6D8932 keep their colours

agencies.label: SEPTA
agencies.source: septa-bus.zip: buses are 1A1818 (near black, not informative) on 116 routes and EF3340 on 24, the most common informative colour; Metro lines L1 0097D6, B F26100, M1 5F249F, T 5A960A, G1 FFD700, D DC2E6B keep theirs

agencies.label: VIA
agencies.source: via.zip route_color 2D5DA2 on 33 of 88 routes, the most common; CB2128 and 609FBF mark other route families

agencies.label: MTS
agencies.source: mts.zip route_color 000099 on 84 of 98 bus routes; Trolley Blue 0000FF, Green 009900, Orange FF6600, Copper B87333 keep their colours

rules.label: Rapid
rules.source: mts.zip route_color CC0000 on the 10 Rapid routes, 201 to 290

agencies.label: Rapid KL
agencies.source: rapid-bus.zip route_color 008716 on 79 of 137 routes, the most common (006CFF on the 48 trunk routes); the rail lines keep their colours (Kelana Jaya D50032, Ampang E57200, Sri Petaling 76232F, Kajang 047940, Putrajaya FFCD00, Monorail 84BD00, Shah Alam 00A9E0); mrt-feeder.zip gives none

agencies.label: KTM
agencies.source: ktmb.zip gives each line its own colour (Seremban 3C5A9F, Port Klang DC2420, ETS FFC72C, intercity grey 6E6E6E); the Seremban Line blue stands for KTM, approximate

agencies.label: OTP
agencies.source: namtang.zip publishes 124 agencies; route_color 9400D3 (the joint suburban buses) is the most common, on 392 of 2,066 routes; BTS, MRT and the SRT lines keep their own colours
